GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.102, recorded on 2026-10-22 in BYOK mode: the CLI ran against a local
OpenAI-compatible model, with no GitHub token. The streams are trimmed as the spike's appendix
(docs/plan/proposal-copilot-cli.md) says. This is not a contract recording of the GitHub-routed CLI:
the GitHub-routed shapes are recorded by task 8.1 of the copilot-cli change.
The directory name is not a plain version, so it adds no entry to recorded_versions.json.
